message: Did you guys see the latest FictionSphere update? MysticQuill really outdid themselves this time!
Absolutely! The way they tied the lore together was genius. Can't believe we have such talented writers in our midst.
I heard MysticQuill might be attending the FictionSphere con next month. There are some insider information saying he books the hotel under the name of Quill Merlin.
That would be amazing if we could meet him in person. Honesty, this can be a big news if it's true.
Agree! But I also feel his mysterious identity makes him and FictionSphere special.
